title: Son of David
gist: God promised David a son whose throne would last for ever (2 Samuel 7). The Gospels open by naming Jesus 'son of David' and the title is used by the blind and by the crowds who ask for mercy, and who greet him at Jerusalem. It is a royal and messianic title that Jesus accepts, and then stretches: how can David call his own descendant 'Lord'?
original: Hebrew ben David; Greek huios Dauid.

passages.note: The promise of an everlasting house and throne.
The first words of the New Testament.
Jesus asks how David's son can be David's Lord (Psalm 110).
